title: SEED family's annulus draw duplicated verbatim in both seed branches instead of one shared draw
location: core/growth.odin:694-701 (and the identical block at core/growth.odin:714-721)
evidence:
core/growth.odin:694-701:
				seed_attempt = true
				router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
				dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
				lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
				hi := span
				if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
				}
				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
core/growth.odin:714-721 (identical):
			seed_attempt = true
			router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
			dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
			lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
			hi := span
			if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
			}
			dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
The branch comment itself concedes the duplication: "Same draws as the coin-miss / branch below (the pre-5.12 annulus draw) — the family is the / draw + the fresh-area predicate applied after the draw."
detail: The PR semantically unifies both branches into one SEED family (same draws, same growth_seed_sep_ok predicate, both flag seed_attempt) yet keeps two verbatim draw copies. A future edit to one copy silently desyncs rng interleaving between the two paths.
recommended_fix: Extract one seed-draw helper (or restructure as coin-hit-and-eligible ? attach : seed). Identical rng call order, so behavior-preserving with no re-bless consequence.

title: Group_Cluster_View dead-slot id-0 sentinel hazard (id 0 is a valid cluster id) documented only at the consumer, not the type
location: core/growth.odin:121-127 (type doc) vs core/growth.odin:631-632 (sole hazard note)
detail: This PR proved the trap is real (the pre-existing 5.12 router-anchor defect) and guarded the one id-matching consumer, but the sentinel invariant stays implicit at the consumer site; a future id-match consumer reads the type doc first.
recommended_fix: Add one line to the Group_Cluster_View doc: dead slots keep id 0 (a valid cluster id — cluster 0); id-match consumers must guard node_alive/kind (see growth_plan_demand's member pick).
